note: Ground truth for benchmark/php-tickets/app (a Laravel helpdesk with a Symfony billing service in billing/ and a Drupal custom module in portal/). Never copy this file into the audited directory. Same format and matching rules as benchmark/answer-key.json: `locations` are files relative to app/ with 1-based inclusive line ranges of the vulnerable statement or of the code a fix changes; a finding matches by its primary location only (window, nearest entry wins). When a real finding is scored as unmatched, check the range against the code, then fix the key, not the finding.

seeded.class: Laravel: Eloquent find by id not scoped to the user (IDOR)
seeded.why: GET /tickets/{id} loads Ticket::findOrFail($id) with comments and attachments for any signed-in user; no policy call and no user scope, unlike index, update and the API controller.

seeded.class: Laravel: whereRaw with interpolated request input (SQL injection)
seeded.why: The search term q is interpolated into whereRaw("subject LIKE '%{$q}%'"); the user scope does not help, the injected SQL can read other tables.

seeded.class: Laravel: mass assignment of $request->all() on a model with $guarded = []
seeded.why: Validation covers name and email, but update($request->all()) writes every field and User has no fillable list, so a user sets is_admin=1 on their own profile and passes the admin gate.

seeded.class: Laravel: API route outside the auth:sanctum group (missing auth middleware)
seeded.why: GET /api/reports/export has no middleware and returns a CSV of up to 5000 tickets with customer emails and subjects to anonymous callers.

seeded.class: Laravel: unescaped Blade output {!! !!} of user content (stored XSS)
seeded.why: Comment bodies are stored as typed (CommentController keeps HTML) and rendered with {!! $comment->body !!}, so a customer's comment runs script in the staff member's session.

seeded.class: Laravel: state-changing routes excluded from CSRF verification
seeded.why: 'account/*' turns off CSRF for POST /account/profile and /account/avatar: another site can change a signed-in user's email (and, with the mass assignment, more) through a cross-site form.

seeded.class: Laravel: upload stored on the public disk under the client file name
seeded.why: Any file type up to 10 MB is saved with getClientOriginalName() on the public disk: .html or .svg files are served from the app origin (stored XSS), names overwrite earlier attachments, and attachments of private tickets are reachable by guessable URL.

seeded.class: Symfony: Doctrine DQL built by string concatenation, not scoped to the customer
seeded.why: searchByNumber() concatenates the number query parameter into DQL (DQL injection) and never filters by customer, so any customer lists every invoice.

seeded.class: Symfony: repository find() by id without an owner check or #[IsGranted] voter (IDOR)
seeded.why: The class-level IsGranted('ROLE_USER') and access_control only require login; show() renders any invoice by id, while pdf() next to it asks the voter.

seeded.class: Drupal: route with _access: 'TRUE' serving private data
seeded.why: /portal/api/tickets/{ticket_id} is open to anonymous visitors and returns any ticket's subject, body and owner uid by id.

seeded.class: Drupal: database query built by concatenation (SQL injection)
seeded.why: The cc query parameter is concatenated into \Drupal::database()->query(); placeholders are used on the line above but not here, and the query is not limited to the current user either.
/portal/tickets/{id}/close changes a ticket on a plain GET with only a permission check, so an image tag on another site closes the visitor's tickets; reopen carries _csrf_token.
Markup::create marks the last reply as safe, so render arrays skip Xss::filterAdmin and the reply's HTML (written by the customer or arriving by e-mail) runs in the portal.

decoys.why: update() calls the policy (owner or admin) and validates only subject and priority.
selectRaw is a constant and whereRaw binds $from as a parameter; the route is behind can:admin.
Ticket::create gets the FormRequest's validated fields plus the user id from the session; user_id in $fillable is never taken from the request.
The mail webhook is public and CSRF-exempt by design; it verifies an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with hash_equals before any write.
Admin routes carry auth and can:admin (Gate on is_admin), so destroy and the reports need no check of their own.

{!! nl2br(e($ticket->body)) !!} escapes first and only adds
tags.
Avatars are validated as jpg/png/webp images up to 2 MB and stored under a generated name.
findForCustomer uses QueryBuilder parameters and filters by the signed-in customer.
pdf() calls denyAccessUnlessGranted('VIEW') and the voter compares the invoice's customer with the user.
/portal/status is public on purpose and returns a constant status object.
The own-tickets query uses a :uid placeholder bound to the current user.
The reopen route requires _csrf_token: 'TRUE' and a permission, and setStatus is scoped to the current uid.
#markup built with $this->t() and @ placeholders, which are escaped.
APP_DEBUG=true is only in the local .env.example; config/app.php defaults debug to false.
